text: The 519 continues to meet the required catchment residency provision and these recommended appointments comply with the Public Appointments Policy and the Relationship Framework between the City of Toronto and Community Centres. The 519’s Nominations Committee short-listed seven candidates for an open election for six available positions. The Committee interviewed all candidates using a standard template of questions focused on how the nominees see themselves contributing in supporting our work at The 519; and how their skills, expertise and lived experience advances our commitment to our Strategic Priorities. Elections were held via secret ballot at the Annual General Meeting 2019. The 519 Membership elected these candidates for appointment by Toronto and East York Community Council. These elected appointments meet the requirements under the City of Toronto’s Public Appointments Policy…

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed the following nominees for a two-year term ending September 30, 2021 or until their successors are appointed: David Morris Tom Spence Tom Warner Biko Beauttah Pam Hrick Paul Noble 2. Appointed the following nominee for a term ending September 30, 2020 or until a successor is appointed: Sarah Zerihun
